verified_cases: a seat area with capacity 300 and zero free seats in the target slot reports capacity=300, free_count=0, state=FULL and capacity_is_slot_availability=false
a study room can be FREE and NOT_PREPARABLE at the same time when the requested party size is outside minUser/maxUser
same-name areas, same-name scenes and same-name rooms return candidates with distinct stable ids; no page or seat is chosen by array order

repeated, short or missing own-order pages keep the rows already verified, set complete=false and expose the page to continue or retry; order_detail keeps a found record and reports the partial search
fees are integer fen; display values are produced by exact integer division (123456 -> 1234.56) and never multiplied by 100
unknown refund or approval enums keep UNKNOWN plus a digest, make the overall state UNKNOWN and never claim success, payment receipt or refund settlement
other people's occupancy is reduced to start_time, end_time and platform_status; synthetic names, logins, subjects and phone numbers do not enter public output
all library and sports read operations remain registered and executable with library/sports write switches disabled
missing room duration rules are MISSING, not 0/1440; wrong types are TYPE_MISMATCH; ambiguous sports cancelTime units stay UNIT_AMBIGUOUS with a null value
library 503/maintenance, 429 with retry_after_ms, login expiry and parser failures remain distinct from a real empty result
holdings copy visibility, account borrow eligibility and third-party electronic authorization remain separate; off-campus access stays UNVERIFIED
renewal eligibility is a hint only and never changes due_at or claims an execution result
own reservation results record the actual page size, status bitmask and date range; seat history records the fixed 20-row page size
a newly queried result is marked LIVE_AT_CHECKED_AT; a cursor continuation is marked SNAPSHOT_ONLY_NOT_LIVE with the original checked_at
limits: Offline synthetic verification only: no real campus login, catalog/loan read, seat/room read, sports availability or order read was performed.
sports.orders still reads the single page requested by the caller; cross-page duplicate detection is used by collect_pages and order_detail, not by a one-page query.
Room rules are per room; the top-level precheck only marks PER_ROOM and never applies one room's rule to another.
Seat and room fee state is UNKNOWN when the source reports no fee; the module does not infer that the service is free.
Sports cancelTime/deadlineTime units remain ambiguous; real cancellation deadlines still require the official page or batch-5 verification.
